article.title: Abatement of obstruction of easement.
article.content: Notwithstanding the provisions of section 24, the dominant owner cannot himself abate a wrongful obstruction of an easement.
article.html:
36Abatement of obstruction of easement.

Section 36 · Chapter IV · page 15 of the Act

Notwithstanding the provisions of section 24, the dominant owner cannot himself abate a wrongful obstruction of an easement.
